description: This file defines multiple grain interface contracts used in Orleans, each specifying tasks related to activation and deactivation behaviors for different grain functionalities.

classes.name: ISimpleActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain with methods to perform an action and to deactivate itself.

classes.name: ITailCallActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain with methods for an action and deactivation, likely including tail call behavior.

classes.name: ILongRunningActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain with methods to perform actions and deactivate, possibly representing long-running tasks.

classes.name: IBadActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Interface indicating a grain expected to throw exceptions and retrieve its key.

classes.name: IBadConstructorTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain with a simple method, possibly used for testing constructor-related issues.

classes.name: ITaskActionActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain with action and deactivation methods.

classes.name: ICreateGrainReferenceTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain capable of creating references and forwarding calls to other grains.

classes.name: IDeactivatingWhileActivatingTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that performs actions while deactivating or during activation.
